subject: seg18: when precaching lands, precache the dynamic-import closure of src/assistant/Markdown.tsx (and the reader's ink/KaTeX chunks) within the size budget
body: Use a build-time manifest of each lazy route/renderer's import closure, not broad globs. Keep the precache under a stated byte budget, and pass the S22 size checks. Add an offline e2e: open the assistant offline and markdown renders.
